verdict.rationale: Mastra ships official TypeScript packages (@mastra/core, @mastra/mcp-docs-server, etc.) with documented APIs for agents, tools, memory, workflows, and streaming, and community reports corroborate real-world usage building against these SDKs (mastra-comm-1, mastra-comm-3, mastra-comm-5, mastra-comm-9). missing for 10: independent API stability/versioning guarantees and broader third-party SDK audits beyond community anecdotes.
